input.title: Validate TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES as an integer
input.body:
File: src/config.ts

The issue arises from setting TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES to a non-integer value like "12h". The code attempts to parse it as an integer, leading to incorrect behavior. The solution is to validate that the TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variable is always provided in minutes and is an integer, and to fail service startup if this is not the case.
